deployments_detail.use: AI+robotics predictive maintenance toward 365/24 smart factories by FY2029
Image-recognition AI for auto product discrimination in logistics (using own "KIOXIA AiSAQ" tech, with Tsubakimoto/EAGLYS)
High-capacity enterprise SSDs for generative AI (KIOXIA LC9 Series)

Deep-learning automated defect classification of in-line inspection images at the Yokkaichi flash-memory fab, replacing human visual judgment. Processes several hundred thousand inspection images per day. [in-house deep learning]
Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) / ML to automatically extract and classify wafer defect patterns, automating the defect-identification analysis process. [in-house (NMF)]
Machine-learning analysis of manufacturing data to infer root causes of device failure and automatically detect early signs of defects (anomaly detection) across the fab. [in-house ML]

Digital twin of the fab (systems, human tasks, judgment records) running AI/ML-based simulation for optimization and prediction of manufacturing operations, fed by ~3 billion data points/day (Hadoop/HBase/Spark). [in-house; Apache Hadoop/HBase/Spark]

GAN/ML pipeline generating synthetic SEM images from CAD layout to localize defects, then LVS circuit analysis to predict electrical test pass/fail from physical defect information. [in-house (GAN + LVS), presented SPIE Advanced Lithography 2021]
deployments_detail.value: electrical-test pass-rate prediction improved from 56% to 73%

deployments_detail.use: Bayesian statistical modeling to determine optimal manufacturing-equipment settings for quality control, shifting from experience-based to data-driven process control. [in-house (Bayesian modeling)]
AI/ML-driven optimization of automated guided vehicles (AGVs) transporting wafer workpieces through the cleanroom. [in-house ML]

Adoption of Synopsys AI Fusion (AI-driven design-space optimization in Fusion Compiler) for SoC/chip physical design; DSO.ai was also evaluated but AI Fusion was chosen for lower resource cost. [Synopsys AI Fusion / DSO.ai]
deployments_detail.value: up to 10% leakage-power reduction; 80% cost savings vs DSO.ai

deployments_detail.use: KIOXIA AiSAQ, an in-house SSD-optimized approximate-nearest-neighbor vector-search engine for RAG/generative-AI workloads; open-sourced and integrated into the Milvus vector database to scale RAG without large DRAM. [KIOXIA AiSAQ (open source); Milvus/Zilliz]
